info.name: Training
info.description: A training collection for exploring and testing various API endpoints including Articles, Categories, Tags, Products, Company Profile, Careers, and Testimonials. Built on a Strapi-based backend using environment variables for base URL and document IDs.

item.name: Article

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of articles sorted by date in ascending order. Supports filtering by title and populating the associated category name. Uses query parameters for sorting, pagination, population, and filtering.

item.name: Company Profile
